count_model_parameters: count the number of parameters in a PyTorch nn.Module model
sample_greedy_tokens: sample next tokens from logits using greedy argmax decoding
sample_probability_tokens: sample next tokens from logits using temperature-scaled softmax sampling
load_greedy_sampler: load a greedy sampler function for next-token generation from logits
load_probability_sampler: load a probability sampler function with temperature for next-token generation
